From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Jan 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP: milestones, responsibilities & proposed close — Medivance

Hi Elena — thanks again for a great discovery today. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (Medivance_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) we discussed. Quick recap and asks: 

- Target close date proposed: 2026-03-31 (we mapped milestones to align with your Q2 launch window).
- Key milestones:
  • Pilot kickoff (customer sandbox) — target 2026-02-15 — owner: Medivance (Tom)
  • SOC2 evidence & security review — target 2026-02-28 — owner: Medivance (security/procurement)
  • Dedicated capacity reservation & sizing sign-off — target 2026-03-08 — owner: Redwood (Marissa)
  • Integration smoke test & performance validation — target 2026-03-22 — owner: Redwood (Soojin)
- Dependencies called out in the sheet: data residency confirmation, sample traffic profile, and SOC2 artifacts.

Next steps I propose: please review v1.2 and indicate any changes to owners/dates by EOD next week (Jan 13). If acceptable, we'll circulate v1.3 with internal assignments and preliminary pricing.

I've cc'd Marissa (pricing/commits) so she can prepare an initial estimate and Soojin will own technical dependencies after we confirm the sample traffic.

Attachments: Medivance_MAP_v1.2.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to syncing.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medivance.com>

Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: milestones, responsibilities & proposed close — Medivance

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few items from our side after review:

1) SOC2 evidence: we'll need our security team to confirm acceptable artifacts. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the SOC2 Type II report + system description? If so, that shortens review time.
2) Data residency: this is owned by our Legal & Privacy team — can we loop Legal early? Who on your team handles contractual data residency language?
3) Pilot environment: we prefer a one-week pilot window starting the week of 2/22 — is that flexible?

Tom and I flagged a calendar conflict around your 2/15 pilot date; attached is our procurement calendar for visibility. On owners: please mark Legal as internal owner of data residency task for now; we may assign a technical contact later.

Thanks — Elena

Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP: milestones, responsibilities & proposed close — Medivance

Folks — forwarding Elena's notes. Action items I want to lock in on our side: 

- Soojin: please confirm technical feasibility for a 2/22 pilot (sandbox readiness, data residency options, and required sample traffic schema). Can you pre-populate the technical dependency column in v1.3?
- Marissa: please prepare a committed pricing estimate and a brief note on Dedicated vs Hosted options for the customer; include any SLA/volume discounts we should propose.

I'll consolidate and send v1.3 (draft) back to Elena by EOD Wed (1/14). I'm attaching a template draft I've started (Medivance_MAP_v1.3_draft.xlsx) with your columns to fill.

Also note: Legal gets looped next if Elena confirms. We should pre-draft standard data residency clauses.

—
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Quick update — I filled pricing and committed dates into the v1.3 draft and left inline comments on a couple of assumptions (expected monthly token volume, burst profile). Key callouts:

- Pricing assumes 3-month pilot with Dedicated pool sizing estimate for initial throughput.
- SOC2 evidence request marked as a gating item — noted target date Jan 22 in the sheet. If Medivance can't provide the artifacts by then, we'd need to push the pilot.
- I've attached a cleaner v1.3 for review (Medivance_MAP_v1.3.xlsx).

Please confirm the dates are realistic; Soojin, can you confirm the technical items by EOD Monday (1/19)?

Thanks,

Hi Elena / Tom — quick weekly checkpoint and nudge on outstanding items. I've attached a consolidated v1.4 of the MAP (Medivance_MAP_v1.4.xlsx) that reflects the pricing, proposed pilot window, and the gating dependencies. Summary below (pulling from the sheet):

Status snapshot:
- Pilot kickoff (customer sandbox) — proposed 2026-02-22 — owner: Medivance (Tom) — STATUS: pending confirmation
- SOC2 evidence & security review — due 2026-01-22 — owner: Medivance (Security) — STATUS: overdue (no artifacts received)
- Dedicated capacity sign-off — due 2026-03-08 — owner: Redwood (Marissa) — STATUS: on track
- Integration smoke test — due 2026-03-22 — owner: Redwood (Soojin) — STATUS: awaiting sample traffic

Outstanding asks from Medivance: please confirm SOC2 artifacts (Type II + system description acceptable?), and nominate a Legal contact for data residency language. If we don't get SOC2 artifacts by EOD Friday (1/22) we risk shifting the pilot start by ~2–3 weeks.

Quick links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/MW-4321), MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEF-medivance-map), SOW draft/DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/placeholder-SOW-Medivance).

Attachments: Medivance_MAP_v1.4.xlsx

Please reply with confirmations or proposed changes — if helpful, I can schedule a short 20-minute sync this week to clear blockers.

Thanks —
